items.title: Is BXP (BXP) Still Trading At A Discount As Its Dividend Holds Firm?
items.summary: Dividend affirmation puts BXP in focus BXP (BXP) reaffirmed its regular cash dividend, with the board declaring a quarterly payout of $0.70 per share for the July to September 2026 period. The reaffirmed payout comes as BXP trades at US$62.43, with the share price down about 10% over the past month and weaker 1-year total shareholder return of roughly 13%, even though the 3-year total shareholder return remains positive.
